title: Beats lab
caption: Two nearby frequencies added at one point. The slow dashed envelope swells and shrinks; the ear hears a loud moment at every bulge, top or bottom.

title: Two speakers, one listener
caption: Two speakers on a wall, a listener walking a line 4 metres out. The readout gives the path difference in wavelengths.

title: Adding two equal waves
caption: Two arrows of equal length, set apart by the phase difference. The long arrow is what the ear gets, and the bar on the right tracks its length.
